exposure: maternal and cord blood metabolite profile
outcome: levels of VLDL and LDL particles
ratio of triglycerides to phosphoglycerides (TG/PG ratio)
cohort: 572 mother-child dyads from the RADIEL study, which recruited women at high risk for gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: Ascending early growth in offspring was associated with lower maternal total cholesterol in HDL in the 2nd and 3rd trimester, and higher VLDL size and more adverse TG/PG ratio in cord blood.
